situation: Dividing the chore: close the window

lines.speaker: A
lines.korean: 오늘 창문 닫기 누가 할 거야?
lines.romanization: oneul changmun datgi nuga hal geoya?
lines.meaning: Who is going to close the window today?

lines.speaker: A
lines.korean: 고마워. 그럼 나는 다른 거 할게.
lines.romanization: gomawo. geureom naneun dareun geo halge.
lines.meaning: Thanks. Then I will do something else.

teachingPoint: 내가 할게 is a natural casual way to volunteer.
